_comment: Source-affecting variation for read.c:tshirt_text and erode_obj_text. The debug Wizard wishes a burnt T-shirt, which readobjnam.c marks as eroded before the ordinary read command; this reaches wipeout_text rather than its zero-erosion return. Seed 87242019 and timestamp 20460315101500 provide an independent character clock/setup, while the item letter o follows the C-observed same inventory ordering.
